title: Fearsome Threesome Edition with Fetzer, Hagopian and Winter
text:
Russia is to attacking command-and-control centers in Ukraine, many of which are located in underground bunkers. I suspect a ground push on Kiev is at hand. The US Embassy has begun evacuating its staff from Russia. whose patience has worn thin. Major NATO allies have blocked a plan to send more aid to Ukraine.
Iran vows “harsh” response to the latest US attacks in violation of the ceasefire, where Trump says “there’s no rush” to settle the war, a suggestion with which the rest of the world would strongly disagree. Tucker says Israel is “not a democracy” on Israeli television, even as the West and Israel plot the militarization of immigration brought about by war. Trump’s $1.5 trillion military budget may be headed for disaster.
Winter Watch featured many stories of great interest, including Hunter Biden’s interview with Candace Owens, where he invited her to go to the Vatican with him. The War Path History video on the historic 1571 battle of Molodi that transformed warfare and ended Mongol dominance is here.
Trump promises (again and again) that a “deal” with Iran is coming “in 24 hours”, which never comes.
